identity.name: Focus Taiwan
identity.description: The English-language news service of Taiwan's Central News Agency, covering Taiwanese politics, cross-strait relations, business, society and culture.

ownership.ownershipNotes: CNA is Taiwan's government-funded national news agency. It operates as a professional wire service but is institutionally tied to the state and its Taiwan/ROC framing.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Government-funded national agency with professional wire standards; coverage is Taiwan-centred and follows ROC institutional framing without being a party organ.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centrist with a pro-Taiwan, pro-democracy institutional lens.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage reports Taiwan's export and technology economy without a strong ideological programme.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Taiwan national lens with clear attention to cross-strait security and democratic institutions.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established national news agency with named reporters and professional standards; state funding requires transparency.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Focus Taiwan.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Taiwanese wire-service coverage in English, strong on cross-strait relations, domestic politics and the technology economy.

selectionRationale: Adds essential Taiwanese national coverage and a counterpoint to mainland Chinese and Hong Kong perspectives.

research.researchNotes: Official About page accessible. FeedBurner endpoint validated. State funding and ownership recorded separately from editorial assessment. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
